candidate.name: intraday_market_close_location_profile_synchronization_240m
candidate.mechanism: Same-date leave-one-out market synchronization of the fixed-clock continuous own-bar close-location pressure profile.
candidate.formula: For d_i=log(high_i/low_i), use s_i=0 if d_i=0 and otherwise s_i=(log(close_i/low_i)-log(high_i/close_i))/d_i. Return the equal-clock-weight population Pearson correlation between the complete 240-state stock profile and its same-date leave-one-out peer mean.
candidate.exact_support_predicate: The raw stock-day has the exact immutable 241-row identity; all 240 selected HLC tuples are finite, strictly positive, and ordered low<=close<=high; zero ranges contribute exact neutral state zero; every own state is finite in [-1,1]; every position has at least 50 other complete profiles; and own and leave-one-out market vectors both have strictly positive population variance.
candidate.zero_semantics: A zero-range bar is retained at the same clock as state zero. There is no positive-range-count, adjacent-pair, return, activity, event-history, imputation, epsilon, smoothing, threshold, dropped-bar, or bridge rule.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_close_location_pressure_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use continuous close location inside each contemporaneous high-low interval.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Pressure is an order-invariant own-stock directional aggregate. Campaign099 retains all clock positions and measures correlation to a leave-one-out market profile; profiles with the same own-stock mean can have different synchronization.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_close_location_total_variation_238p

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_market_range_profile_synchronization_240m
